name: Edge-Cut Re-framing
description: Replaced the global "sequence linking pairs" requirement with a local edge-cut requirement: an agreement is critical if its removal separates the key patent holders into two non-empty sets. Preserved the "minimum total fee of a valid subset" objective to strictly adhere to the H2 constraint. Models that pattern-match path unions will fail to recognize the equivalence; models that naively simulate the edge cuts will TLE ($O(n^2)$). Only models that deduce the structural equivalence on trees will achieve the required $O(n)$ time.
